columns.name: source
columns.description: MT = SDK [MOVE-TRACE]; HSD = HSD.MoveDiag mod; CV = SDK [CLASSVAR] bridge_classvar_get output; LOG = engine level-load line

columns.name: side
columns.description: cl = S21 client prediction, sv = S3 dedi; from the log prefix Native(C)/Script(S)/... or --side (LOG rows: from the folder)

columns.name: session
columns.description: log session: the GUID folder of the file (platform/logs/<side>/<GUID>/), else the name of its folder; one game process

columns.name: kind
columns.description: cmd (MT) | classvar (CV) | map (LOG) | frame | evt | takeoff | land | mark | run | setting | dump | dumpfile | init | error

columns.name: wall
columns.description: log-sink wall clock from the [YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.mmm] file prefix, as seconds since 1970 reading the logged local time as if UTC; ms resolution; time the line was written, not simulation time; empty on console copies

columns.name: run
columns.description: HSD: value of hsd_md_run when the line was printed

columns.name: seq
columns.description: HSD: per-VM line counter (gaps = lost lines)

columns.name: ent
columns.description: MT ent= / HSD ent= entity index

columns.name: pox
columns.description: MT: origin x after the move

columns.name: poy
columns.description: MT: origin y after the move

columns.name: poz
columns.description: MT: origin z after the move

columns.name: pvx
columns.description: MT: velocity x after the move

columns.name: pvy
columns.description: MT: velocity y after the move

columns.name: pvz
columns.description: MT: velocity z after the move

columns.name: ground
columns.description: 1/0; MT ge= (ground entity before the move); HSD IsOnGround(); -1 = API unavailable

columns.name: slide
columns.description: 1/0; MT slide= (before the move); HSD IsSliding(); -1 = unavailable

columns.name: buttons
columns.description: MT b= m_nButtons (held) as integer; bits per in_buttons.h

columns.name: vtype
columns.description: HSD setting getter that succeeded: float|int|string|ERR

columns.name: value
columns.description: HSD setting value as printed; LOG map: the map name

columns.name: where
columns.description: HSD error: which mod function contained the error

columns.name: ing_airtime
columns.description: mod: Time() between sampled takeoff and landing

columns.name: ing_groundtime
columns.description: mod: Time() on the ground before a takeoff

columns.name: ing_takeoff
columns.description: mod: horizontal speed at the takeoff sample

columns.name: ing_peak
columns.description: mod: max horizontal speed sampled in the air

columns.name: ing_land
columns.description: mod: horizontal speed at the landing sample

columns.name: ing_hop
columns.description: mod: consecutive takeoffs with < 0.1 s ground time

columns.name: drv_run
columns.description: trial id: HSD run if present, else MT burst index

columns.name: drv_burst
columns.description: MT: index of a contiguous command range (gap > --burst-gap cmds starts a new one)

columns.name: drv_batch
columns.description: MT: reset batch within the stream; +1 when cmd goes backwards, or jumps > --burst-gap across a level load / VM start / dedi RESPAWN / position jump (TELEMETRY-SCHEMA.md 5)

columns.name: drv_join
columns.description: MT: ok = paired with the other side's line for the same usercmd on (session, ent, drv_batch, cmd); none; ambiguous (more than one candidate)

columns.name: drv_dspd2d
columns.description: MT: post - pre horizontal speed within one command

columns.name: drv_dheading
columns.description: MT: change of horizontal velocity direction within one command

columns.name: drv_dt
columns.description: HSD: t - previous t of the same side/kind; MT: drv_dt_est

columns.name: drv_dt_est
columns.description: MT: |po_xy - o_xy| / |pv_xy| when |pv_xy| > 20 u/s (assumes origin += post velocity * frametime and no collision; positions are printed with 3 decimals, so the relative error is about 0.0005 u / displacement)

columns.name: drv_accel2d
columns.description: HSD: (spd2d - prev spd2d) / drv_dt; MT: drv_dspd2d / drv_dt_est

columns.name: drv_pressed
columns.description: MT: buttons pressed this command vs the previous line of the stream

columns.name: drv_wish_yaw
columns.description: HSD client: yaw + atan2(-ax_right, ax_fwd); empty without input
